# Petty Tech Solutions — Official brand assets

## Approved master

These files derive from the explicitly approved horizontal PTS + PETTY TECH SOLUTIONS logo. The colored `logo-full.svg` and `logo-mark.svg` are byte-for-byte copies of the approved masters. Do not redraw, retype, stretch, rotate, recolor, alter spacing, remove the ring or add effects. The PTS monogram, broken circular ring and outlined wordmark are the official identity.

All logo SVGs contain genuine vector paths and fills. No PNG, screenshot, embedded raster, live text or external font is required. PNGs are exported directly from those vectors in sRGB. The four full/mark PNG exports have transparent backgrounds.

## Files and usage

| File | Use / dimensions |
| --- | --- |
| logo-full.svg | Primary horizontal colored lockup, 410:79 ratio; website header and footer |
| logo-mark.svg | Colored monogram and ring only, 305:210 ratio; About graphic and compact branding |
| logo-full-white.svg | Solid-white knockout of identical full-logo geometry for dark backgrounds or one-color printing |
| logo-mark-white.svg | Solid-white knockout of identical monogram/ring geometry |
| favicon.svg | Small-size flat blue/white version on navy; same approved silhouettes with metallic details removed |
| logo-social.png | 1024 × 1024 navy square; centered colored mark with circular-crop-safe padding |
| logo-full.png | Transparent 3280 × 632 (8× the vector viewBox) |
| logo-mark.png | Transparent 2440 × 1680 (8× the vector viewBox) |
| logo-full-white.png | Transparent 3280 × 632 |
| logo-mark-white.png | Transparent 2440 × 1680 |
| favicon-32.png | 32 × 32 PNG fallback for browsers |
| apple-touch-icon.png | 180 × 180 icon for device bookmarks |
| social-sharing.svg | Existing 1200 × 630 social-sharing card, unchanged; editable source |
| social-sharing.png | Matching 1200 × 630 Open Graph / Twitter image |
| brand-guide.md | This document |

The white versions intentionally remove color and metallic effects, but do not change geometry or proportions. Use the colored approved logo on the website; do not replace it with the white variant without a design reason.

## Typography

- PTS and PETTY TECH are custom geometric outlines in the approved artwork. There is no exact font to install or type to reproduce them. Always use the supplied asset.
- SOLUTIONS originated from widely spaced DejaVu Sans Regular and is now outlined. Its original construction uses a 16-unit em size with 11 additional units between glyph advances before the full-logo transform. Do not retype this as website text.
- For supporting text, the existing website stack is `Inter, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif`; it loads no external fonts. Segoe UI or Arial are practical system-font alternatives. DejaVu Sans is a practical alternative for spaced supporting uppercase text, not a replacement for the wordmark.

## Backgrounds and spacing

- Dark navy: use the original colored versions for the approved metallic/blue appearance. Use white versions where a single-color treatment is needed.
- Light backgrounds: do not use the white knockout. Because the silver highlights are very light, place the colored logo on a navy panel with clear space; no unapproved dark/recolored logo is supplied.
- Photos or busy backgrounds: use a quiet solid navy panel rather than shadows, glow or outlines added to the mark.
- Maintain clear space around the artwork of at least one quarter of the circular ring's diameter. Keep other type and graphics outside this area where the composition allows.
- Use SVG on websites and maintain the intrinsic aspect ratio with `height:auto`. Never independently set width and height to incompatible ratios.
- Current approved header widths remain 204 px desktop, 185 px at the intermediate breakpoint, and 190 px mobile. SOLUTIONS is a small secondary line at these sizes; do not shrink the full lockup further. Prefer at least 260 px when every word must be readily readable. For smaller placements, use the mark only with an accessible business name nearby.
- Favicon is the only simplified rendering. At 16 px the ring and PTS silhouette carry recognition; the full wordmark is not intended for that size.
- Social avatar: the artwork occupies a centered 680 × 468 region inside a 1024 × 1024 image. Its furthest bounding-box corner is within the 512 px circular crop radius. Keep this padding; do not zoom to fill the square.
- PNGs are for platforms that reject SVG. Do not enlarge beyond their native pixel size. High-resolution transparent files are not intended to be loaded at full size in a website header.

## Website mapping

The website loads `assets/brand/logo-full.svg` in the shared desktop/mobile header and footer, `assets/brand/logo-mark.svg` in About and structured data, `assets/brand/favicon.svg` with its PNG fallback, and `assets/brand/apple-touch-icon.png`. Social metadata uses `assets/brand/social-sharing.png`; the square profile PNG is for account avatars, not a replacement for the wide Open Graph card.

No publishing, DNS, layout, content, animation, responsiveness or contact behavior was changed to install this package.
